title: A new or changed editorial policy makes a stored check stale
description: Found on Machines on Machines, 2026-11-05: after adding the no-self-reference rule, editorial check-version on the live article reported 0 findings with skipped unchanged and an old checkedAt, while a direct editorial check found 2 real findings. reusable_check_run in src/papyrus_content/editorial_checks.py reuses a stored run by content hash and section only, so policies never invalidate it. packVersion is not enough, because adding a new policy at version 1 does not change it. The key must include what was checked: a digest of the policies that apply. Keep the rule that identical content under identical policies is never sent to the provider again. Do not re-check every story when a policy changes: this is the check of one version when asked for, or on its next save. A reader must be able to tell a reused result from a fresh one.
